computed_caveat: Computed cells propagate both bound orbits with SGP4 as their element sets stand, with no burn: where the pair goes if the red track does not move, so every row whose action does not move it shares one figure. Our response is not applied to the blue orbit yet, so every response in a computed row has the same closest approach, and the ranking within it is decided by lookup figures. Element-set error, which the sweep takes as 1 km at epoch plus 2 km a day in LEO and 2 km plus 1 km a day at GEO, is not in it.
